method: Viewed every complete native tool-returned illustration, then final actual browser overview and phone layout. Reviewed lettering corrections in the final overview.

images.observations: Recognizable Black Petal character, greenhouse and silver glove; broad pale title space and dark author area. Actual pose is nearly frontal rather than the requested three-quarter view.
Adult queen with dark skin, thorn circlet and ivory collar. Strong face and quiet pale top; a few additional thorn branches remain subordinate.
Detective and closed red umbrella with readable hands. Bridge has more lamps/tower detail than the minimal brief, concentrated below broad dark title space.
Distinct adult male, raven, moon and distant manor. Very dark treatment with subdued face values; character remains visible but is less immediately legible than pale-background examples.
One black orchid and silver stem, no person. Petal tip enters the requested title zone and red root enters the default author zone; final separate typography was moved clear of both.
Two adult profiles, clear romantic staging, one visible hand against the man’s coat. Actual hand interaction differs from requested pair of touching hands; no claim of exact scene compliance.
Silver-haired adult woman, key and doorway. Facial rendering appears younger than the age48 brief; restrained costume and quiet upper space are retained.
Bearded adult and a sculptural petal-like wave. Large face is readable but low-key; textured water is confined beneath spacious dark sky.
Auburn-haired adult, blank envelope and side branch. Branch intruded on centered lettering; title was moved into the clear upper-right region without changing the source image.
Single silver-edged dark doorway, bright opening and crimson flower. Strong architectural silhouette and quiet surrounding space; no character.

scope: Ten illustrative adaptations of a shared visual reference; no exact style/identity repeatability or recipient approval inferred.
final_lettering_review: Sample title and author placements are legible in the final mockups;05 and09 use adjusted positions to fit actual art.
